name: Four Seasons Hotel St. Louis
positioning: Modern riverside hotel in downtown St. Louis overlooking the Mississippi River and Gateway Arch National Park
best_for: Guests who want a riverside base overlooking the Gateway Arch National Park
Guests who like a rooftop outdoor pool and a Topgolf Swing Suite

facts.text: Four Seasons Hotel St. Louis is at 999 North 2nd Street.
The hotel has 200 rooms in total.
The hotel overlooks the Mississippi River, Gateway Arch National Park and the St. Louis skyline.
The hotel is on the west bank of the Mississippi.
The design is a modern riverside building enclosed in a 650-foot (198-metre) glass light box.
The glass light box has 500,000 LED lights.
The hotel comprises 15 floors of a 19-floor building.
Ramsay's Kitchen by Gordon Ramsay is the hotel's restaurant.
RK Bar is a rooftop bar with views of the Gateway Arch.
Lambert-St. Louis International Airport is 20 minutes by car from the hotel.
The Fitness Centre is open 24 hours.

highlights.text: The eighth-floor Sky Terrace has an outdoor swimming pool.
The Arch-View Room has floor-to-ceiling windows framing the Gateway Arch.
The hotel has the first-ever Topgolf Swing Suite in downtown St. Louis.
The Spa After Dark Experience gives exclusive use of the 12,000-square-foot spa.
The hotel has a USD 7 million modern art collection.

considerations.text: Overnight valet parking is USD 65 plus tax per night.
Guests must be ages 16 or over to access the spa facilities.
Spa treatments run from 9:00 am to 6:00 pm daily.
WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing reflects the high-end positioning.

perks.text: With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, breakfast for two is free daily.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a priority upgrade if available at check-in.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a $100 hotel credit.
WhataHotel special offers can be combined with the exclusive perks.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get free Wi-Fi access.
